name: Copenhagen
tagline: Three Michelin stars of Nordic cuisine, and the smørrebrød that's been served the same way since 1877.

Geranium.description: Avant-garde Nordic cuisine named the world's best restaurant in 2022 and 2023. Three Michelin stars, reviewed by critic Andy Hayler.

Restaurant Schønnemann.description: A smørrebrød institution since 1877, with more than 100 hand-written variations on the menu.

Kadeau.description: A piece of Bornholm island in Christianshavn, with seasonal Danish ingredients. Three Michelin stars.

Jordnær.description: Just 25 seats on the first floor of the Gentofte Hotel, run by the Vildgaard couple. Three Michelin stars.

Noma.description: René Redzepi's lab on Refshalevej, the birthplace of modern Nordic cuisine. The sole focus of the Copenhagen episode of "Parts Unknown."
